This root is found chiefly in cool temperate climates, especially in mountains.

Even in suitable terrain, it remains very hard to find.

To obtain its properties, it is prepared in liquid form.

Level 5H Reduction poison. Its bluish extract can cause severe effects, including blindness through destruction of the optic nerve, and inflicts 1–10 concussion hits.
